world.asset_policy: Use neutral adult catalogue members, not improvised anatomy. Jordan uses man and the unnamed colleague uses woman consistently. No unverified pointing hand, handshake or expressive close-up. When a pose is unavailable, the work-object change carries the meaning.
world.set: Muted desk edges, chair backs, walls and unlabelled office papers establish a setting without extra teaching content.

story.setting: One everyday office with desk, conversation table, board and calendar bays.
story.arc: Tense judgement becomes evidence, impact, listening and a shared habit. Practice precedes a complete meeting; a later-time return resolves the opening.

devices.what: Opening desk returns with the same document and schedule positions, first unresolved and finally on time.
Held paper slots carry settled wording and in-place replacements. Definitions and comparisons use calm emphasis.
Recurring deliverable, milestone and downstream work objects show consequences. Spoken approval counts become individual papers.
Held planning slots receive evidence, impact, perspective and the agreed plan. Plan objects are a habit slip and calendar checkpoint.
Neutral adult rigs shift conversational orientation toward a shared work object. No emotional score or humiliating acting.
Office paper carries a work slip into a pocket rule and turns the choice sheet into a workflow preview. Hard-cut alternatives preserve its position.

value_script.why: Posture and unresolved work establish tension.
Chapter change shades the office, not Jordan.
Emphasise the listening pause through stillness.
A common work object carries collaboration.
Retain the working grade through recap.
Identify the phrase, not a bad person.
Isolate co-creation on the single dark mechanism break.
Set up practice without a preferred option.

value_script.accent: C, then B's compliment, then C
value_script.why: Colour follows discussion; a boxed check marks the answer.
Extract partnership without a scale metaphor.
A physical page prepares the full workflow.
Opening composition returns with improved work and open orientation.
